inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the 2009 agreement is another warning that students and families are being made to bear the cost of a dispute between government and union leaders. The government should meet its obligations, but it must also uphold order and insist that education is not held hostage by threats of an indefinite nationwide strike. A responsible settlement matters; so does putting students’ future ahead of political pressure.
